hero.headline: The floor still matters
hero.sub: Benjamin Lovell Shoes fits leather on Chestnut Street and across four more shops. Brands you can hold. Staff who actually measure. Independent shoe stores in Rittenhouse, Old City, Glen Eagle, Spring House, and Allen's. Shop the floor, not a warehouse photo.

offerings.heading: Five shops, <mark>one standard.</mark>
items: Rittenhouse and Old City for the city walkers who want leather that lasts.
Glen Eagle and Spring House when you want the same fit without Center City parking.
Allen's Shoes in the family, with the SAS sale the site still shouts about.

story.heading: What people say about us
paragraphs: The shops are still shops. You walk in, you try the pair, you leave with something that bends the way your foot actually bends.
Rittenhouse, Old City, Glen Eagle, Spring House, and Allen's share the same idea: independent retail with a real fitting bench.
Find them at 1728 Chestnut Street, Philadelphia, PA 19103. Call 215.564.4655. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.

experience.heading: How a visit should go.
items: Tell them how you walk. They will pull last and width, not just size.
New-in-store sits on the table, not buried three clicks down.
Events and brand days are posted when they are real, not invented.

feature.heading: Fit first, then the receipt
feature.text: A shoe store that still measures is rarer than a new drop. That is the whole pitch, and it is the one the reviews keep repeating. Rittenhouse and Old City for the city walkers who want leather that lasts.

contact.heading: Find the shop that <mark>fits.</mark>
contact.sub: Start at 1728 Chestnut Street or confirm the other four on the official site. Find them at 1728 Chestnut Street, Philadelphia, PA 19103. Call 215.564.4655. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.
